decisions.reason: The existing message-53 MODIFY already records the accepted custom-fabricated stainless-steel spout and rendering-match requirement.
The existing message-53 MODIFY already requires the wiring plan to include the accepted solenoid valve and button-control circuit.
The existing message-53 MODIFY already captures the solenoid-valve actuation mechanism and press-to-open, release-to-stop behavior.
The existing message-53 MODIFY already records the accepted gravity-fed solenoid path and absence of retained matcha in the spout or tubing.
The message's independent placard change is already fully represented by the existing message-53 MODIFY.
Accepting specific BOM components does not change the requirement to deliver a system layout or establish a new top-level layout attribute.
The accepted spout and solenoid approach does not modify the existing splash-minimization requirement.
Message 53 reiterates that the spout faces the baristas, which is already the candidate's current orientation and introduces no state change.
The selected spout and valve components do not alter the existing requirement that seals prevent leakage into the base.
The BOM change concerns the dispensing mechanism and spout, not bowl capacity, depth, or refill policy.
The accepted dispensing components do not change the required structural support or operational-stability behavior.
The accepted solenoid and custom-spout approach does not replace or modify the existing requirement that the spout be removable or easy to flush and clean.
